deck_file.ask: Deck layout file saved from PyLabRobot (lh.deck.save)
deck_file.help: Build the deck once in PyLabRobot (carriers, tip racks, plates, sites with the names agents will use) and save it with lh.deck.save('deck.json'). Every name in a request must exist in this file.

deck.ask: Instrument deck when the file is absent

device_address.ask: USB device address when more than one Hamilton is connected

serial_number.ask: Instrument serial number to select by

volume_cap.ask: Largest volume (uL) the mounted tips or pipette allow
